lines.speaker: night_clerk
lines.text: Chamber's closed. I am required to be here and you are required not to be, so let us both be reasonable about it and neither of us write anything down.

lines.speaker: night_clerk
lines.text: The vote was at four. What happens at one in the morning is schedules, annexes, and the instruments that give effect to the thing that was voted on. Nobody votes on those. Nobody reads those. I witness those.

lines.speaker: night_clerk
lines.text: Eleven signatures tonight and I witnessed every one. Four of them I could not tell you the employer of, and I am required by standing order to ask, and I did ask, and they told me, and I still could not tell you.

choices.text: Who signed and could not be placed?
Why write it down if nobody reads it?

lines.speaker: night_clerk
lines.text: Your clause is in the instrument, not just in the treaty. That matters more than anybody in that chamber realised — the treaty can be superseded and the instrument has to be executed. I copied it into the schedule myself at two in the morning because I could not sleep.

lines.speaker: night_clerk
lines.text: No treaty to give effect to, so no instruments, so no signatures. I sat here until four with an empty register and a pen, and it was the worst night of my working life, and I have had some.
